title: Photo #008: dirt mound where creature was seen standing on hind legs when shot
description: Color landscape photo of a sagebrush-covered dirt mound at the edge of an eroded wash, with layered pale bluffs and blue sky in the background. Caption: "Photo #008 – Dirt mound where creature was seen standing on hind legs when shot by" followed by a 1843(a)(2) redaction.
